given.note: Dee W. sends the ready text her booking's chat link types (MC C9; RULES 4.1b: 'When they send it, the chat opens and is saved'), evt-dee-0001, by iMessage. Her phone row was written by Sam's booking with no chat open (commit-adds-dee-booking: version 1, chat_open false, never stopped, no time or way), and her booking notice waits for the chat (mark-waiting-chat). The row is closed and not stopped, so the call opens it: chat open since the text's receipt, by iMessage, the version raised to 2, and one phone.chat_opened entry with the closed chat's old values. The turn that answers her text then commits (commit-supersedes-waiting, trace-dee-0011, 14:00:02Z), and its answer supersedes the waiting notice (RULES 4.1b: 'Nothing sent before is sent again').
